title: van in the Past: voltam, voltál, volt...

sections.title: A new stem, familiar endings
sections.content: van ("to be") is already irregular in the present — vagyok, vagy, van — and it's irregular in the past too, switching to a completely different stem: volt-. The good news is that once you have that stem, the personal endings are the exact same ones you've been using all unit: voltam looks and behaves just like dolgoztam.

items.english: Ildikó and Gábor were in Budapest.

sections.content: Unlike van itself, which changes shape a lot across persons (vagyok, vagy, van, vagyunk...), volt stays exactly the same and just takes the regular past endings on top — no other verb in this unit is quite this easy to conjugate once you know the stem.
